{"headline": "Japan’s Takaichi calls population decline a ‘quietly advancing national crisis’", "bullets": ["Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi told parliament on Monday that population decline is a \"quietly advancing national crisis.\"", "Takaichi pledged to formulate a comprehensive population strategy by the end of 2026."]}

{"headline": "U.S. military says latest strike on alleged drug-smuggling boat in Caribbean kills 4", "bullets": ["The U.S. military struck a suspected drug-smuggling boat in the Caribbean Sea on Sunday, killing four people, and has now killed at least 235 in 70 strikes since September 2025.", "The military offered no evidence the vessel carried drugs, and Guatemala denied a U.S. claim that it agreed to joint operations on its soil."]}

hindu|https://www.thehindu.com/business/.text: {"headline": "Non-tariff barriers are biggest hurdle in India-China trade, says Nirmala Sitharaman", "bullets": ["Sitharaman said non-tariff barriers are the biggest hurdle in India-China trade, with China using phytosanitary measures despite India seeking market access for generic medicines, bovine meat and vegetables.", "She said the first phase of the India-U.S. trade pact has been finalised and is undergoing legal drafting, and hoped it would be concluded at the earliest."]}

{"headline": "Export levy on petrol hiked, diesel lowered", "bullets": ["The government raised the export levy on petrol to Rs 2.5 per litre from Rs 0.5 and cut the diesel levy to Rs 8.5 per litre from Rs 16.", "The ATF export levy stayed at Rs 10.5 per litre, and domestic retail fuel duties were unchanged, with the rates applying from October 16 for fifteen days."]}

{"headline": "Air India sets up multi-disciplinary panel to identify cost-saving opportunities", "bullets": ["New CEO Tewolde Gebremariam set up a full-time cross-functional Cost Savings Team to review all expenditure and find savings across the organisation.", "Air India's consolidated loss widened to Rs 22,238.23 crore in the year ended March 2026 from Rs 10,858.83 crore a year earlier, as total income fell to Rs 71,869.94 crore."]}

{"headline": "Reliance responds to Elon Musk’s allegations, says it welcomes competition", "bullets": ["Reliance said it welcomes competition in satellite communications, including Starlink, after Musk accused unnamed oligarchs of blocking Starlink's Indian license.", "India's government said its framework is fair and non-discriminatory, with Starlink, Jio Satellite and Eutelsat OneWeb all holding satcom licenses but awaiting final security clearance and spectrum allocation."]}

{"headline": "Finances for raising a child", "bullets": ["Raising a child to age 25 costs a middle-class semi-urban or urban household Rs 75 lakh to Rs 2 crore, and an upper-middle-class family Rs 2-4 crore.", "Education inflation runs at 10-12% a year, so an SIP of Rs 20,000-30,000 a month stepped up 10% annually can build Rs 2.88-4.32 crore in 18 years at 12% CAGR."]}

{"headline": "Rupee rises 20 paise to 94.79 against U.S. dollar in early trade", "bullets": ["The rupee gained 20 paise to 94.79 against the dollar in early trade on Friday, after closing at 94.99 on Thursday, helped by a softer dollar and RBI forex interventions.", "The dollar index fell 0.54% to 102 while Brent crude traded at $105.35 a barrel, and Sensex dropped 113 points to 74,187 as FIIs sold equities worth Rs 5,285.37 crore."]}

{"headline": "IGL launches AI-powered pilot project for hydrotesting verification", "bullets": ["Indraprastha Gas Ltd launched an AI pilot at ten retail CNG stations, using cameras to read vehicle registration numbers and check cylinder hydrotest status via the PESO portal.", "CNG cylinders must be hydrotested every three years at a PESO-approved centre, and IGL said in early September it would stop dispensing CNG to vehicles without a valid certificate."]}

{"headline": "Stock markets trade lower during early session amid profit-taking", "bullets": ["The Sensex fell 113 points to 74,187 and the Nifty dropped 27.20 points to 22,967.15 in early trade, a day after Thursday's sharp rally.", "Tech Mahindra surged 5% on a 32.74% jump in September-quarter net profit to Rs 1,585.6 crore, while FIIs sold equities worth Rs 5,285.37 crore on Thursday."]}

hindu|https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/.text: {"headline": "Meta releases weights for Muse Spark Open", "bullets": ["Meta released the weights for Muse Spark Open, an 816-billion-parameter natively multimodal model with 42B active parameters and a 1M-token context window.", "The model is available via API platforms and downloads on Amazon SageMaker AI, Google Cloud Model Garden, Hugging Face, and Microsoft Foundry Models under the Muse Model License."]}

hindu|https://www.thehindu.com/business/.text: {"headline": "Rupee trades in narrow range against U.S. dollar in early trade", "bullets": ["The rupee opened at 96.20 and slipped to 96.26 against the dollar, down 1 paisa, after closing at a two-month low of 96.25 on October 1.", "India's forex reserves fell $18.343 billion to $747.557 billion in the week ended September 25, as the RBI intervened to cap rupee losses and the MPC is expected to raise the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50% on October 7."]}

{"headline": "Next-Gen GST and India’s next phase of growth", "bullets": ["Next-Gen GST rate changes took effect on September 22, 2025, aiming to reduce and rationalise rates and ease compliance.", "The next phase of process reforms will come before the GST Council shortly, following nine years of GST implementation since 2017."]}

{"headline": "Gold, silver lose lustre in September", "bullets": ["Gold and silver both posted negative returns in September as a stronger U.S. dollar and expectations of a U.S. interest rate hike weighed on prices.", "Rising crude oil prices did not help precious metals either."]}

{"headline": "Netflix names former Disney executive Rice as new content chief as Bajaria departs", "bullets": ["Netflix appointed former Disney executive Peter Rice as chief content officer, succeeding Bela Bajaria, who leaves after nearly a decade at the platform.", "Rice starts October 26 overseeing series, films and live events, a day after Netflix laid off 6% of its workforce, roughly 1,000 employees."]}

{"headline": "Tata Trusts case: Mehil Mistry matter hearing postponed to Nov 5", "bullets": ["The Maharashtra Charity Commissioner's office postponed the hearing of former Tata Trusts trustee Mehil Mistry's complaint to November 5, 2026.", "Mistry alleges trustees Vijay Singh and Venu Srinivasan were appointed to the Bai Hirabai Trust in violation of its deed requiring Parsi Zoroastrian trustees resident in Mumbai or Navsari."]}

{"headline": "Experts' poll: RBI may hike rates by 0.25% in October policy amid inflationary pressures", "bullets": ["A PTI poll of 16 economists and bankers expects the RBI to raise the repo rate by 0.25% from 5.25% at its October 7, 2026 review, the first hike since February 2023.", "Retail inflation rose to an eight-month high of 4.82% in August from 4.45% in July, and experts see at least two hikes in FY27 plus an upward revision to the RBI's FY27 CPI forecast."]}

{"headline": "Government raises deepwater gas price ceiling to $9.89/MMBtu; APM gas cap at $7", "bullets": ["The ceiling price for gas from difficult fields like Reliance-BP's KG-D6 rose to $9.89 per MMBtu for October 2026 to March 2027, up from $8.90.", "The APM price for ONGC and OIL legacy fields stays capped at $7 per MMBtu, with new-well gas allowed up to $7.70."]}

hindu|https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/.text: {"headline": "Land shortage cripples Agriculture Ministry’s weather network rollout", "bullets": ["Only 113 automatic weather stations (9.4% of target) and 1,730 automatic rain gauges (4%) were installed as of September 9, leaving about 48,700 sensors short.", "Private partners blame a land shortage and a December 2025 rule change limiting rooftop rain gauges to 10-15%, which the IMD says is needed for accurate data."]}

hindu|https://www.thehindu.com/business/.text: {"headline": "Korea to explore business opportunities in Karnataka sectors", "bullets": ["A high-level Korean business delegation met Karnataka Minister Priyank Kharge in Bengaluru on Saturday to explore investment, business expansion and technology partnerships.", "The delegation included representatives from DSC Investment, GS Ventures, CJ CheilJedang, CJ Investment, Capstone Partners and GTGO Inc., covering technology, food and beverage, retail and start-ups."]}

{"headline": "India sourced more than two-thirds of its August oil imports from just three countries", "bullets": ["Russia, the U.S. and the UAE supplied a record share of over two-thirds of India's oil imports in August 2026.", "Russia's share fell to about 44% in August from a historic high of 51% in July, while U.S. and UAE volumes surged, with American oil at a substantial premium to India's average import price."]}
